refnamediv.refpurpose: Check for the stability of a discrete-time system.

listitem.para: K x 6 second-order section matrix. Each row corresponds to the coefficients of a second-order filter.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `isstable` function checks whether a discrete-time system is stable. A discrete-time system is stable if all poles of the system function are inside the unit circle in the z-plane.

- When called with `b` and `a`, the function checks the stability of the filter defined by these coefficients. - When called with `sos`, the function checks the stability of the filter defined by the second-order section matrix.
The function returns `flag = 1` if the system is stable, and `flag = 0` otherwise.
